# 3 bed detached house for sale

> An excellent opportunity to acquire a well-proportioned three-bedroom detached bungalow, ideally suited to first-time buyers, downsizers or those looking for a comfortable home within easy reach of the town centre. The property occupies a generous site with a tarmacadam driveway providing ample off-street parking, enclosed by a wall boundary.
